mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_index_version SET build_status='FAILED' WHERE index_version=#{version} AND build_status='BUILDING'
mapper.select: SELECT head_id FROM knowledge_index_head WHERE head_id=1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_index_chunk(index_version,chunk_id,document_key,content_version,document_hash,text_hash,section_title,chunk_text,embedding,metadata_json,brand_code,document_type,region) VALUES (#{version},#{chunkId},#{documentKey},#{contentVersion},#{documentHash},#{textHash},#{sectionTitle},#{content},CAST(#{vector} AS vector),CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb),#{brand},#{type},#{region})
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_index_version SET build_status='PUBLISHED',chunk_count=#{count},published_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE index_version=#{version} AND build_status='BUILDING'
UPDATE knowledge_index_head SET index_version=#{version} WHERE head_id=1
mapper.select: SELECT v.* FROM knowledge_index_head h JOIN knowledge_index_version v ON h.index_version=v.index_version WHERE h.head_id=1 AND v.build_status='PUBLISHED'
SELECT chunk_id,document_hash,text_hash,section_title,metadata_json::text AS metadata_json FROM knowledge_index_chunk WHERE index_version=#{version} ORDER BY chunk_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.sql: index_version=#{version} AND brand_code=#{brand} AND document_type=#{type} AND region='CN_MAINLAND'
mapper.select: SELECT chunk_id,(CASE WHEN LOWER(CONCAT(section_title,' ',chunk_text)) LIKE LOWER(#{term}) ESCAPE '!' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS score FROM knowledge_index_chunk WHERE ORDER BY score DESC,chunk_id LIMIT #{limit}

WITH legal AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT chunk_id,embedding FROM knowledge_index_chunk WHERE ) SELECT chunk_id,embedding <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector) AS distance FROM legal ORDER BY distance,chunk_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT chunk_id,embedding <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector) AS distance FROM knowledge_index_chunk WHERE ORDER BY embedding <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector) LIMIT #{limit}
